miduil · Nov 21, 2026

       This vulnerability was discovered by Johan Carlsson and we were informed by GitLab on 2026-11-12.
       Initially we set 2026-11-25 for a coordinated disclosure;
       due to the new Ruby2Shell bug GitLab had to update earlier
       and thus we also disclosed the GPGME bug on 2026-11-20.
I guess pretty important for GitLab since it supports signed commits, code execution in that path is pretty bad.

You can find the GitLab Omnibus related patch here: https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/omnibus-gitlab/-/commit/279ac3...
